Container for cards

Source: R/cards.R
boxLayout.Rd

Container for cards

Usage

boxLayout(..., .list = NULL, type = c("group", "deck", "columns"))

Arguments

...

Slot for box().

.list

Optional list of cards.

type

Layout type. One of:

  • "group": Bootstrap .card-group — flex row with no gaps, merged borders, and equal-height columns.

  • "deck": Bootstrap 5 grid cards — responsive row with gutters and equal heights per row (.row.row-cols-* + .h-100). Replaces the removed .card-deck from Bootstrap 4.

  • "columns": Deprecated. Bootstrap 5 removed .card-columns. A bslib::layout_column_wrap() fallback is used, but prefer calling bslib::layout_column_wrap() directly for new code.

See also

Other cards: box()

Examples

boxLayout(
  box("Revenue", title = "KPI"),
  box("Trend", title = "Chart"),
  type = "deck"
)
